scripts.title: S_c_r_a_p ESP
scripts.script:
local input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local fld = workspace.Misc.Zones.LootingItems.Scrap
local active = false

if _G.xyz123 then 
	pcall(function() _G.xyz123() end) 
end

local function wipe()
	local all = fld:GetDescendants()
	for i = 1, #all do
		local item = all[i]
		if item.Name == "Scrap_H" then
			item:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function check()
	if active == false then wipe() return end
	
	local items = fld:GetChildren()
	for _, v in pairs(items) do
		if v.Name == "ScrapNormal" then
			local main = v:FindFirstChild("GearMain")
			if main then
				local l = main:FindFirstChild("PointLight")
				if l and l.Enabled then
					if not v:FindFirstChild("Scrap_H") then
						local high = Instance.new("Highlight", v)
						high.Name = "Scrap_H"
						high.FillColor = Color3.new(0, 0.4, 1)
						high.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 1, 1)
						high.FillTransparency = 0.441
						high.DepthMode = "AlwaysOnTop"
					end
				else
					local old = v:FindFirstChild("Scrap_H")
					if old then old:Destroy() end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

input.InputBegan:Connect(function(k, g)
	if g then return end
	if k.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F8 then
		active = true
		print("on")
	elseif k.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F10 then
		active = false
		wipe()
		print("off")
	end
end)

local function loop()
	if _G.xyz123 ~= nil then
		check()
		task.wait(0.372)
		loop()
	end
end

_G.xyz123 = function()
	_G.xyz123 = nil
	active = false
	wipe()
end

task.spawn(loop)

scripts.title: Survival Stamina Higher
scripts.script:
local P=game:GetService("Players")
local LP=P.LocalPlayer
local W=workspace
local T={"StaminaRegen","Stamina","CombatStamina"}
local PID=13977939077

local function patch(S)
	for _,n in ipairs(T) do
		local o=S:FindFirstChild(n)
		if o then
			o.Value=100
			o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()o.Value=100 end)
		end
	end
end

local function watch(F)
	local S=F:FindFirstChild("Stats")
	if S then patch(S) end
	F.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)if c.Name=="Stats"then patch(c)end end)
end

local function setup()
	local _=LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local F=W:WaitForChild(LP.Name)
	watch(F)
end

task.delay(3,function()
	if game.PlaceId~=PID then return end
	setup()
	LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		local F=W:WaitForChild(LP.Name)
		watch(F)
	end)
end)

-- JAI
